scope.refusal.message.unknown: This target may not be scanned.
scope.refusal.message.invalid_target: Not a valid scan target here: malformed, loopback, link-local, cloud metadata, or a private address outside every scan zone.
scope.refusal.message.deny_list: The platform does not allow this target.
scope.refusal.message.excluded: An active scope exclusion covers this target.
scope.refusal.message.rejected: Your organization marked this name, or a name above it, as not yours.
scope.refusal.message.needs_review: This asset's ownership is waiting for review.
scope.refusal.message.candidate: This asset is a discovery candidate; its ownership is not confirmed.
scope.refusal.message.dependency: This name runs on third-party infrastructure; only passive and takeover checks apply.
scope.refusal.message.monitor_only: This asset is watched passively only.
scope.refusal.message.no_entry: No scope entry, seed or verified domain covers this target.
scope.refusal.message.entry_pending: The scope entry that covers this target is waiting for approval.
scope.refusal.message.entry_expired: The scope entry that covered this target has expired.
scope.refusal.message.entry_inactive: The scope entry that covers this target is deactivated.
scope.refusal.message.tier_exceeds: The scope entries covering this target do not allow this probe's tier.
scope.refusal.message.proof_required: This probe needs a verified domain of your organization.
scope.refusal.message.out_of_data_scope: This asset is outside your data scope.
scope.refusal.message.not_an_asset: You may scan only assets in your data scope.
scope.refusal.message.zone_none: No scan zone covers this private target.
scope.refusal.message.zone_no_sensor: The scan zone of this target has no sensors.
scope.refusal.message.zone_sensor_mismat: The chosen sensor is not in this target's scan zone.
scope.refusal.message.program_platform: Platform sensors never probe bug-bounty program targets; use your own sensors.
scope.error.PUBLIC_SUFFIX: A public suffix (such as com.vn or azurewebsites.net) cannot be a scope entry. Enter a domain your organization registered.
scope.error.DENY_LIST: The platform does not allow this target as a scope entry.
scope.error.CIDR_TOO_LARGE: This address range is larger than the platform allows. Split it into smaller ranges.
scope.error.ONE_OFF_TOO_LONG: A one-off entry cannot last longer than your organization allows.
scope.error.ONE_OFF_DISABLED: Your organization does not allow one-off scope entries.
scope.error.REASON_REQUIRED: Say why this target may be probed. The reason is kept in the audit log.
scope.error.REQUEST_NOT_ALLOWED: Your organization does not accept scope requests from members.
scope.error.REQUEST_MUST_BE_ONE_OFF: A request must expire. Choose how many days it lasts.
scope.error.REQUEST_MUST_BE_SINGLE: A request covers one name or address. Wildcards and ranges need an approver.
scope.error.REQUEST_TIER: A request cannot ask for intrusive (T2) probes.
scope.error.INTRUSIVE_TOO_LONG: An intrusive (T2) entry cannot last longer than your organization allows. An owner sets the limit in Scope settings.
scope.error.INTRUSIVE_NEEDS_EXPIRY: Intrusive (T2) entries must expire in your organization (an owner may allow permanent ones) and need an approval.
scope.error.WIDENING_NEEDS_APPROVER: Only a scope approver can widen what may be probed.
scope.error.ENTRY_SELF_APPROVAL: You requested this change, so another approver must approve it.
scope.error.SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED: You can approve your own entry only as an owner, and only when nobody else can approve it. Ask one of the approvers listed on the entry.
scope.error.SELF_APPROVAL_REASON_REQUIRE: Say why this entry may take effect without a second person. The reason is kept in the audit log.
scope.error.SELF_APPROVAL_NEEDS_TOTP: Approving your own entry needs a code from your authenticator app. Turn on two-factor authentication in your account first.
scope.error.SELF_APPROVAL_INVALID_CODE: That code is wrong or was already used. Wait for your authenticator to show a new one.
scope.error.REMINDER_TOO_SOON: The approvers were reminded less than an hour ago.
scope.error.ENTRY_NOT_PENDING: This entry is not waiting for approval any more.
scope.error.ENTRY_EXPIRED: This entry expired. Renew it with a new expiry instead.
scope.error.ENTRY_REJECTED: This entry was rejected. Create a new one if it is still needed.
scope.error.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Confirm your identity to make this change.
scope.error.STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE: This change needs you to confirm your identity, and your account has no way to do that here. Sign out and sign in again, then retry.
scope.error.PROOF_REQUIRED: These targets need a verified domain of your organization for this kind of scan. Verify the domain, or run the scan on your own sensor.
scope.error.TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Some targets may not be scanned. See each target for the reason.
scope.error.WILDCARD_TARGET: This wildcard cannot be a scan target: write *.example.com for a domain your organization may scan (not a public suffix or a shared provider domain), in the targets rather than the scanner settings.
scope.error.TARGET_SELECTOR_UNAVAILABLE: The *.domain or address range targets could not be read from the inventory, so the run was not started. Try again.
scope.pending.left1: One thing left before it can be scanned:
scope.pending.leftN: {n} things left before it can be scanned:
scope.pending.mine: You asked for {pattern}, so another approver must approve it.
scope.pending.tier: This scan probes at {probe}; the entry allows {entry}. Raise the entry tier.
scope.pending.proofAsk: A scope approver can verify it.
scope.approvers.nobody: Nobody else in your organization can approve it.
scope.duration.label: Duration
scope.duration.permanentOff: Permanent is off for intrusive (T2) entries in your organization.
scope.entry.noTierCeiling: An entry covers every probe: the scan intensity and the approval rules decide how hard its targets are scanned.
scope.entry.outcomeRequest: A scope approver reviews it. It authorizes nothing until approved.
scope.entry.outcomeApproval1: Needs 1 approval from another approver; it authorizes nothing until then.
scope.entry.outcomeApprovalN: Needs {n} approvals from other approvers; it authorizes nothing until then.
scope.entry.outcomeNow: Takes effect at once. You may be asked to confirm your identity first.
scope.entry.proofT2: Intrusive (T2) probes also need proof that you control {domain}.
scope.entry.proofAll: Scans also need proof that you control {domain}.
scope.entry.proofPlatform: Platform sensors also need proof that you control {domain}; your own sensors need this entry only.
scope.entry.errKind: This is not a domain, IP address, IP range, URL, repository or cloud account. Pick its kind, or check the spelling.
scope.entry.toastRequestHint: A scope approver will review it. It authorizes nothing until then.
scope.entry.toastPendingHint1: It needs 1 approval from another approver before scans may use it.
scope.entry.toastPendingHintN: It needs {n} approvals from other approvers before scans may use it.
scope.entry.errSave: Could not save the scope entry.
scope.entry.descRequest: Ask a scope approver to allow one name or address for a few days. Scans may use it only after it is approved.
scope.entry.descAdd: Say what your organization may probe. Exclusions still win over every entry.
scope.entry.kindsHint: A domain, IP address, IP range, URL, repository or cloud account.
scope.entry.coverSubHint: Pattern *.{name}. Add an exclusion of exactly the domain to leave it out.
scope.entry.coverNameHint: Names below it stay out of scope.
scope.tier.hint.t0: Passive only: DNS, certificates, public sources. Nothing is sent to the target.
scope.tier.hint.t1: Safe active checks: port scans, HTTP probes, non-intrusive templates.
scope.tier.hint.t2: Intrusive tests that may change state. Needs an expiry, an approval and a verified domain.
scope.tier.tools.t2: ZAP web application scans that send attack payloads
scope.entry.letterHint: The entry authorizes probes only while the letter is valid, and stops when it expires or is revoked.
scope.entry.reasonPlaceholder: Why may this be probed? For example: our domain, registrar account 123; pentest ticket OPS-12.
scope.edit.title: Edit scope entry
scope.edit.desc: Type and pattern cannot change; remove the entry and add a new one instead.
scope.edit.widensPending: It goes back to pending and authorizes nothing until another approver approves it.
scope.edit.widensNow: It takes effect at once; every administrator is told. You may be asked to confirm your identity.
scope.edit.widensApprover: Only a scope approver can make this change.
scope.edit.widensNoApproval: Scope entries need no approval while scan approval is not Strict: it takes effect at once; every administrator is told. You may be asked to confirm your identity.
scope.settings.scanApprovalOn: On: scans are approved, not scope entries
scope.settings.scanApprovalStrictHint: Widening waits for the approvals below; intrusive (T2) entries always need one.
scope.settings.scanApprovalOpenHint: Widening takes effect without a second person. Re-authentication, the deny list, audit and notifications still apply.
scope.settings.scanApprovalByOwner: Set by your owner in Settings > Scan approval.
scope.approvals.noneNeeded: Scope entries need no approval while scan approval is not Strict: changes that widen scope take effect at once.
scope.refusal.message.constrained: The scope entries covering this target are limited to some ports or a path, and this job could reach others.
